tasks.subject: Task 1: Add User.name schema field + PATCH /api/account route
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Let an authenticated user set their own display name, persisted as a nullable `User.name` field.

**Files:**
- Modify: `prisma/schema.prisma`
- Modify: `prisma/schema.production.prisma`
- Create: `src/app/api/account/route.ts`
- Test: `src/app/api/account/route.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `User.name` exists as `String?` in both schema files, right after `email`
- [ ] `PATCH /api/account` requires a valid session (any authenticated user, not Owner-only)
- [ ] Rejects a missing/empty/whitespace-only `name` with 400
- [ ] Rejects a `name` longer than 100 characters (after trimming) with 400
- [ ] On success, updates `User.name` for the caller and returns `{ ok: true, name }` with the trimmed value

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/app/api/account/route.test.ts` → all tests pass

**Steps:** Add `name String?` to `User` in both schema files → `npx prisma db push` → `npx prisma generate` → write failing test → write route using `withErrorHandling`/`HttpError`/`parseJsonBody`/`requireSessionApi` → verify passing → commit. Full code in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-11-settings-ui-overhaul-wave1.md Task 1.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["prisma/schema.prisma", "prisma/schema.production.prisma", "src/app/api/account/route.ts", "src/app/api/account/route.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/app/api/account/route.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["User.name exists as String? in both schema files", "PATCH /api/account requires session, rejects empty/oversized name with 400, saves trimmed name on success"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: UpdateNameCard component wired into Account settings page
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Merchants (and Members) can view and update their display name from `/settings/account`.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/components/UpdateNameCard.tsx`
- Test: `src/components/UpdateNameCard.test.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/settings/account/page.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `/settings/account` shows a Name card above the existing Change Password card
- [ ] The Name input is pre-filled with the current user's saved name, or empty if none set
- [ ] Submitting an empty/whitespace name shows an inline error and does not call the API
- [ ] Submitting a valid name calls `PATCH /api/account`, shows success on 200, shows server error on failure
- [ ] A network failure shows "Network error — please try again"

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/components/UpdateNameCard.test.tsx` → all tests pass

**Steps:** Write failing test → build `UpdateNameCard` (styled like `ChangePasswordCard`, `.field`/`.btn` classes) → verify passing → rewrite `src/app/settings/account/page.tsx` as a server component fetching `user.name` and rendering `UpdateNameCard` above `ChangePasswordCard` → manual verification → commit. Full code in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-11-settings-ui-overhaul-wave1.md Task 2.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/components/UpdateNameCard.tsx", "src/components/UpdateNameCard.test.tsx", "src/app/settings/account/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/components/UpdateNameCard.test.tsx", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Name card renders above Change Password on /settings/account", "input pre-filled from server-fetched name", "blank submit shows inline error without calling API", "valid submit calls PATCH /api/account and shows success/error state"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Independent Settings dropdown in the sidebar
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The "Settings" sidebar item toggles its sub-item list open/closed on click, independent of the current route, while still auto-expanding when already on a settings page.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/components/Sidebar.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Clicking "Settings" while on a non-settings page expands the sub-item list without navigating away
- [ ] Clicking "Settings" again collapses the list
- [ ] Loading any `/settings/*` page directly shows the list already expanded
- [ ] The 4 sub-items still navigate on click exactly as before, unchanged active-state highlighting
- [ ] Dashboard/Launch Planner/Guide nav items are unaffected

**Verify:** No automated test exists for `Sidebar.tsx` (consistent with prior settings work) — manual browser verification.

**Steps:** Replace `SettingsNavGroup` with a self-toggling `<button>` (own `useState` initialized from the same path-boundary check already used elsewhere in the file: `pathname === "/settings" || pathname.startsWith("/settings/")`) plus a `CaretRight` chevron icon; sub-items stay `<Link>`s. Manual verification per the 5-step checklist in the plan → commit. Full code in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-11-settings-ui-overhaul-wave1.md Task 3.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/components/Sidebar.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "manual browser verification", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Settings toggles open/closed independent of route", "auto-expanded when landing directly on /settings/*", "sub-item navigation and highlighting unchanged", "other nav items unaffected"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Billing plan-comparison cards
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The Billing settings page shows the 3-tier plan catalog below the existing summary, with the merchant's current tier marked and the others offering Upgrade/Downgrade.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/components/BillingCard.tsx`
- Modify: `src/components/BillingCard.test.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Existing "Plan: X · Status: Y" summary and "Manage billing" button unchanged, render first
- [ ] Below it, a "Change plan" section shows all 3 `PLAN_CATALOG` entries as cards with full feature lists
- [ ] The card matching the merchant's current `planTier` shows "Current plan" instead of a button
- [ ] Higher-tier cards show "Upgrade", lower-tier cards show "Downgrade"
- [ ] When `planTier` is `null`, no card is marked current and all 3 show "Choose plan"
- [ ] Clicking Upgrade/Downgrade/Choose plan calls `POST /api/billing/checkout` with `{ plan: tier }` and redirects on success
- [ ] A checkout failure shows an inline error without disturbing the portal button's own error state

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/components/BillingCard.test.tsx` → all tests pass

**Steps:** Add 4 failing tests to the existing test file → implement the "Change plan" section reusing `PLAN_CATALOG` and `PLAN_TIERS` (tier-index comparison for Upgrade/Downgrade label) → verify passing → manual verification against the demo account → commit. Full code in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-11-settings-ui-overhaul-wave1.md Task 4.
